headline: Samsung Warns AI Chip Shortage Will Deepen as High-Bandwidth Memory Sells Out
summary: Samsung Electronics warned that shortages of artificial intelligence chips will worsen. The South Korean tech giant stated its high-bandwidth memory (HBM) inventory for next year is already fully sold out.
why: Samsung Electronics is the world's largest producer of memory chips and a major supplier of high-bandwidth memory used in AI accelerators.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Supply shortages create strong pricing power for memory producers but constrain global hardware production.

why_moved: Supply constraints for critical HBM memory indicate persistent bottlenecks in global hardware production for artificial intelligence.
